caption: The drawing consists of a square grid positioned centrally on a larger off-white, slightly textured background. Inside the grid, there are repeated blue motifs arranged in diagonal rows. Each motif includes two elliptical leaf-like shapes, crossed by a straight line, and a small rectangular block intersected by a perpendicular short line, collectively resembling stylized insects or mechanical objects. The background inside the square grid is light beige with fine, evenly spaced horizontal and vertical lines, forming a subtle graph paper pattern. The outer area of the paper is blank and pale, featuring no additional objects or markings. The overall use of color is minimal, with blue for the motifs and neutral tones for the background.
title: Calico
